description: Add a job or internship to the tracker. It starts in the applied stage unless you pass another status. Inputs: company and role (both required), an optional deadline as YYYY-MM-DD, an optional source such as LinkedIn or a career fair, an optional type of job or internship, an optional status and optional notes. The tool saves the application on this computer and returns its id, which update_status needs. Example prompt: "Add a Software Intern role at Shopify with a deadline of 2026-11-15, found on LinkedIn."

deadline.description: Last day to apply as YYYY-MM-DD.
